newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-STRANSKY BOOKS TWICKENHAM DATE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-STRANSKY BOOKS TWICKENHAM DATE.

text.p: South African fly-half Joel Stransky kicked 21 points to hoist Leicester into their fourth Pilkington Cup final in five years on Saturday.

Stransky, who scored all his side's 18 points in the quarter-final, landed five penalties and two late drop-goals to set up a 26-13 win over a spirited Gloucester side and ensure a Twickenham final against Sale in May.

The Manchester-based club, coached by former Waikato stalwart John Mitchell, surprised Harlequins 26-16 to reach their first final in the competition's history. It was their third win over the cosmopolitan London side this season.
